name: Inkwell
blurb: A private journal that suggests writing prompts without writing the entries for you.
why: I wanted a journal that could help someone get started without doing the writing for them. Inkwell suggests prompts based on your themes, but you write the entries yourself.
built: Private accounts, theme-based prompts, and scheduled or one-off reminders. The model does not write your entries.

name: Council of LLMs
blurb: Ask several LLMs the same question, compare their responses, and get a combined answer.
why: A single model can miss something or sound more certain than it should. I built Council to compare responses from several models and make their differences easier to inspect.
built: Runs prompts through multiple model providers, compares their responses in judging rounds, and combines them into a final answer.

name: Prompt Lab
blurb: Test prompts across models and compare the responses in one place.
why: Testing prompts across different chat tabs and scripts makes it hard to track which wording or model setting produced which response. I built Prompt Lab to put those comparisons in one place.
built: Edit prompts and model settings, run tests across models, and compare the outputs side by side.

name: Persona Paper Reviewer
blurb: Review research papers with checks specific to HCI and AI-generated personas.
why: General manuscript feedback can miss questions about how personas represent people and how that representation was evaluated. I built PPR to check for these issues alongside a standard paper review.
built: Reviews PDFs, checks revisions against earlier comments, and searches manuscripts for style and terminology issues.

name: PEP — Persona Ecosystem Playground
blurb: Create and examine AI-generated persona sets using your own research material.
why: Building personas from transcripts and other research material takes time. I built PEP to organize that material into persona sets that can be examined, including how they represent minority views.
built: Imports research documents and transcripts, retrieves relevant passages, and uses them to generate and expand persona sets.
